mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, it indicates a weakening labor market that triggers recession fears, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening residential demand, which typically precedes economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods with rising HOUST, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in employment (PAYEMS) signal a deteriorating labor market, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (as indicated by high GDP growth and low unemployment), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods with RSAFS YoY < 0.0% and late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
